_: GM 63 against a sampled reference. Same knobs as GM 62 — one FM stack, so the search has to be the same one — but the reference is the darker and less velocity-dependent of the pair, so the fit is expected to land on lower modulator levels and a shallower sweep rather than on a different mechanism. Level is not in this spec on purpose. Every shape term the loss takes is normalised, so `gain` is free to move several dB for a fraction of a percent of loss and the run's own level warning is the only thing that notices; and a synthetic voice's level is a bank-balance question — judged against its siblings on the same note, not against one product's peak — so it is set with the block rather than fitted per program.
